seo.title: About PriceM8 - Built by a Tradie, For Tradies
seo.description: Learn the story behind PriceM8, created by Michal after 20 years in construction and landscaping. Built to help tradies quote faster, stay profitable, and avoid costly mistakes.

sections.title: Built by a tradie - for tradies.
sections.subtitle: PriceM8 was born from 20 years of real construction experience - not Silicon Valley.

sections.title: 20 years on the tools - and the same quoting problems
paragraphs: I'm Michal, the founder of PriceM8. For the last 20 years I've worked across domestic construction: full house builds, landscaping, garden rooms, timber structures, drainage, kitchens, bathrooms, and more.
And in all those years, one thing never got easier: quoting.

sections.title: The real quoting problems
items: Spending evenings calculating labour and materials
Clients asking for variations and adjustments

sections.title: Why I built PriceM8
paragraphs: Originally, I built PriceM8 for my own business. I wanted a way to price jobs quickly, accurately, and consistently. Something simple, reliable, and made for real-world trades.
When it worked for me, I realised every tradie could benefit from it.

sections.title: What makes PriceM8 different?
paragraphs: Most estimating software is built by people who've never lifted a shovel. PriceM8 is different - built from real experience, real mistakes, real price changes, and real late-night quoting sessions.

sections.quote: If PriceM8 can save you the time and frustration it saved me - then it's already doing its job.
sections.author: Michal, Founder of PriceM8
